context.body: Gospel, Israel, and shared life · Romans 1:8–15
context.label: Gospel, Israel, and shared life

observations.body: Paul longs to share and receive strength in Rome. First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world. So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.
observations.label: Paul longs to share and receive strength in Rome

observations.body: The passage presents Paul longs to share and receive strength in Rome as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Paul longs to share and receive strength in Rome

observations.body: The passage places God beside Paul longs to share and receive strength in Rome.
observations.label: God

payload.posture: Read Romans 1:8–15 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states paul longs to share and receive strength in Rome. First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world. So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
payload.title: Paul longs to share and receive strength in Rome
